title: Rumour that the giant ended up at Wright-Patterson

tellings.quote: that the giant ended up at Wright Patterson."

plain: According to a rumour, a giant said to have been captured in Afghanistan around 2005 was later taken to Wright-Patterson, a US Air Force base in Ohio. Tim Alberino, who tells the giant story as someone close to it, passes this on as something another person told him. If it were true, the base would be holding the body of a creature that should not exist.
